entries.text:
- **Add to cart from the chat**: shoppers ask, the assistant adds the right option and shows View cart and Checkout buttons
- **Ask Aixly**: a support assistant on the Support page that answers from the help center, checks your setup and emails our team when you need a person
- If the assistant can't answer for a moment, shoppers get a form to reach your team instead of an error
- Order lookup only reads the order's email and phone to confirm it's the shopper's

---

- **Online / Away**: click your status on the Chats page to stop offering live chat while you're away from an open tab
- Live chat: if nobody joins within 5 minutes, the assistant takes over again (10 minutes once someone has joined)
- **Chats** in the Shopify admin: the same compact layout as the team inbox, so the conversation gets the space
- Emails from Aixly have a new look, and new stores get a welcome email with the setup steps

---

- **Assigning chats**: give a chat to yourself, a teammate or the store admin; replying claims unowned chats; a **Mine** view; alerts and an email for the assignee
- **Team inbox**: a cleaner layout with more room for the conversation, a profile menu (name, photo, password)
- **28 chat languages**: added Arabic, Czech, Danish, Greek, Finnish, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese; right-to-left layout for Arabic and Hebrew
- Phones: while typing, the chat turns compact so more of the conversation stays visible above the keyboard
- Settings → Team: the invitation link fits the page, with **Copy link** and **New link**
- **Help Center**: search, and screenshots in the articles

---

- **Team inbox**: invite staff to answer chats with their own sign-in, no Shopify access needed (agent and manager roles)
- **Helpdesk connections**: tickets in Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout or any system via webhook
- **Languages**: choose the chat language (store, browser or fixed), translate every text with AI help, reword all hand-off lines
- Phones: the page behind the chat no longer scrolls or shows through above the keyboard

---

**Live chat**

- Real-time live chat: messages, typing indicators and team joins appear instantly
- See what a shopper is typing before they send it
- Previews of your latest messages above the chat button when the shopper has closed the chat
- Missed replies are emailed to shoppers with a **Continue the chat** link
- Sound and in-app alerts on any page, plus email/Slack reminders when a shopper waits 3 minutes
- Photos and PDFs in both directions (JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF up to 5 MB)
- Live chat satisfaction ratings

**Inbox**

- **Suggest reply**: an AI draft of your reply that you edit before sending
- Saved replies with the `/` shortcut and `{first_name}`
- Tags and a tag filter
- Orders placed after chatting shown on the conversation

**Smarter assistant**

- Saved answers and **Correct this answer** apply from the very next message
- **Teach the assistant**: answers your team gives in live chats are suggested for your knowledge base
- Returns filed directly in Shopify from the chat

**Sales**

- **Aixly impact** on the Dashboard, with stricter attribution (only shoppers who actually used the chat)
- Cart reminder with an optional discount code

**Storefront**

- **Embedded chat window**: a theme block that puts the chat inside any page section
- Open the chat from your own buttons (`data-aixly-open`) or JavaScript events (`aixly:open`)
- Shoppers always see that they're chatting with an AI assistant

**Dashboard and support**

- "Where shoppers find the chat" overview with copyable links and code
- Chat activity (visitors, chats, AI replies) with trends vs the previous period, and recent chats with automatic tags
- New **Support** page with privacy and EU compliance guidance

**Widget and admin**

- Icon size control and custom launcher icons
- The Appearance preview shows the real widget, including the chat button
- Mobile: full-screen chat without page scrolling behind it
- Simpler installation using Shopify's standard flow (no extra redirects)

---
- Documentation restructure for the merchant help center

entries.section: Installation & setup › How do I turn on the chat widget?
entries.text: Shopify admin → **Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → Aixly AI Chatbot → Save**. The **Setup Guide** on the app's Dashboard links you there.

entries.section: Installation & setup › Can the assistant add products to the cart?
entries.text: Yes. When a shopper asks for it ("add the blue one", "yes please"), the assistant checks the option and stock, adds it to their cart and shows **View cart** and **Checkout** buttons. If the product has options the shopper hasn't picked (like a color or size), it asks first.

entries.section: Installation & setup › Where do I get help with Aixly?
entries.text: Open **Support → Ask Aixly** in the app. It answers from this help center and checks your store's setup (for example whether the chat is switched on in your theme). If it can't solve something, **Email our team** sends us your question with the details we need, and we reply by email.

entries.section: Installation & setup › Does Aixly change my theme code?
entries.text: No. It uses a theme app embed, which you can switch off at any time.

entries.section: Installation & setup › Which languages are supported?
entries.text:
The assistant replies in the language the shopper writes in. The chat interface is built in for 28 languages (including Korean, Hindi, Arabic and Hebrew, laid out right to left), and follows your store's language (or the shopper's browser, or one language you choose). Translate your own texts in **Settings → Languages**, with AI help.

---

entries.section: The assistant › Where does it get its answers?
entries.text: From your live catalog (products, prices, stock), your Shopify policies, your store pages and your knowledge base. It doesn't make up prices, stock or policies.

entries.section: The assistant › It gave a wrong answer. How do I fix it?
entries.text: Open the conversation in **Chats** and click **Correct this answer** under the reply. Your corrected answer is used from the next message.

entries.section: The assistant › Can shoppers see each other's orders?
entries.text:
No. Order details are only shown after the shopper proves it's their order (order number plus email or phone, or being logged in).

---

entries.section: Live chat › Can my team chat with shoppers?
entries.text: Yes. When a shopper asks for a person, your team replies from **Chats** and the assistant pauses. See **Live chat**.

entries.section: Live chat › Can my staff answer chats without access to my Shopify admin?
entries.text: Yes. Invite them in **Settings → Team**; they sign in to the team inbox with their own account. See **Team inbox**.

entries.section: Live chat › Can I give a chat to a specific person?
entries.text: Yes. Click **Assign** in the conversation and choose a teammate or the store admin. They're notified, and it appears under **Mine** for them. See **Assigning chats**.

entries.section: Live chat › Can team members change their name, password or photo?
entries.text: Yes, from their name at the top right of the team inbox (**Edit profile**, **Change password**).

entries.section: Live chat › Can tickets go to my helpdesk?
entries.text: Yes: Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout or any system via webhook. See **Integrations → Helpdesk**.

entries.section: Live chat › Do I need to keep the app open?
entries.text: Your team counts as available while someone has the app or the team inbox open. You also get email/Slack alerts, including a reminder when a shopper has waited 3 minutes.

entries.section: Live chat › What if the shopper has already left?
entries.text:
If they shared their email, they get your reply by email with a link to continue the same chat.

---
Yes: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB each and 3 per message. Your team can send files too.

entries.section: Shoppers › Can shoppers return items from the chat?
entries.text:
Yes. Verified shoppers choose the items and reason, and a return request appears in Shopify for you to approve.

---

entries.section: Plans & limits › Why did the widget disappear?
entries.text: Most often the Starter plan's monthly conversation limit was reached. Check **Plans** in the app.

entries.section: Plans & limits › Does testing in Settings count toward my limit?
entries.text: No. **Settings → Try your bot** doesn't count toward your conversations.

The top of your **Dashboard** shows the last 30 days:

- **Sales influenced**: revenue and orders from shoppers who used Aixly before buying (see below)
- **Conversations**
- **Handled by the assistant**: the share of conversations resolved without your team
- **Live chat satisfaction**: the share of 4–5 star ratings, the average and the number of ratings

---

An order counts as **influenced by Aixly** when, within **7 days before** the order, the shopper:

- chatted with the assistant or your team, **or**
- clicked or added a product to their cart from the chat, **or**
- used the cart reminder.

Logged-in customers are matched even if they order on another device. Simply opening the chat window doesn't count. Influenced orders also appear on the shopper's conversation in **Chats**.

---

In the app, open **Analytics**:

- Conversations and trends
- Escalations to your team
- Engagement funnel (widget loads → opens → messages → product clicks → add to cart → checkout)
- Influenced orders, revenue and average order value, per day
- Top products shown, clicked, added to cart and purchased
- Usage charges (if your plan has overage billing)

---

- Many conversations but few product clicks: add quick actions for bestsellers, and make your greeting invite product questions.
- Many escalations about the same topic: answer it once in **Teach the assistant**.
- Low satisfaction: read the comments on low ratings in **Chats**, and set up saved replies for consistent answers.

- In the app, open **Appearance**

The preview on the right runs the real storefront widget with your unsaved settings, so what you see is exactly what shoppers get. Click **Save settings** when you're happy. Changes reach your storefront within a couple of minutes.

---

Start from a preset and adjust from there.

---

- Accent color (chat button, header, your shoppers' messages)
- Assistant bubble color
- Assistant text color

---

- Title and subtitle shown in the header
- Avatar: upload an image (it's resized automatically) or use an image URL

---

The preview on this tab shows the closed chat button, as shoppers first see it; click it to open the chat.

- **Position**: left or right
- **Shape**: circle or square (corner radius applies to square buttons)
- **Button size**: small, medium or large
- **Content**: icon, icon + text, or text
- **Icon**: choose a preset or **Upload** your own (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF; it's resized and stored safely, SVG isn't accepted)
- **Icon size**: adjusts the icon inside the button, separately from the button size. At the largest size an uploaded image fills the whole button (great for a round logo).
- **Label**: the text for "icon + text" or "text" buttons
- **Show launcher**: hide the button if you open the chat from your own links instead

---

See **Popups and proactive engagement**.

---

See **Quick actions**.

---

- Widget size (small, medium, large)
- Widget corner radius
- First message (greeting)
- Input placeholder

Give each conversation an owner so the right person answers it, and nobody answers twice.

---

Open the conversation in **Chats** (or in the team inbox) and click **Assign** at the top. Choose:

- **Store admin**: anyone using Aixly in your Shopify admin
- Any **team member** with access to your store (their photo or initials, and their role, are shown)
- **Unassign** to give it back to everyone

Anyone with inbox access can assign, both the store and team members. Reassign a chat any time, for example to a manager who knows your returns policy.

---

entries.section: Chats you reply to become yours
entries.text:
When you reply to, or join, a chat that nobody owns, it's assigned to you automatically. A chat that already belongs to a teammate stays theirs.

---

- **Mine** (next to **Needs reply**) lists the open chats assigned to you.
- In the list, a chat shows **Yours**, or **→ name** for a teammate's.

---

When a teammate assigns a chat to you:

- you hear the alert sound and see a notification while the inbox is open
- team members also get an email with an **Open the chat** link that goes straight to the conversation

---
Pausing or removing a team member (Settings → Team) gives their chats back to everyone, so nothing gets stuck with a person who can't answer.

- In the app, open **Chats**. It has two tabs: **Inbox** and **Teach the assistant**.

Everything updates live: new messages, shoppers typing, and takeovers by teammates.

---

- **Needs reply**: shoppers waiting for your team, and live chats with unread messages
- **Mine**: open chats assigned to you
- **Live**: chats your team is in right now
- **All** and **Closed**
- **Search** messages, email or name
- **Tags**: filter by a tag you added

Each row shows the latest message (or "Typing…"), the status, who it's assigned to, tags and the shopper's rating.

- The full conversation, including what the assistant said and the products it showed
- The shopper's contact details (if they shared them), whether they're logged in, and **orders they placed after chatting**
- A summary for your team when a shopper asked for a person
- **Join chat**, **Hand back to AI**, **Assign** (to yourself, a teammate or the store admin; see **Assigning chats**), **Close** / **Reopen**
- **Tags**: add tags such as *refund* or *vip* with **+ Tag** (up to 10)
- **Correct this answer** under any assistant reply (see **Knowledge base and teaching the assistant**)

See **Live chat** for typing previews, **Suggest reply**, saved replies and attachments.

---

Questions the assistant couldn't answer and answers your team gave, ready to save to your knowledge base. See **Knowledge base and teaching the assistant**.

---

- Keep **Needs reply** empty: those shoppers are waiting.
- Use tags to spot patterns (for example how many chats are about *shipping-delay*).
- Save your most common replies as saved replies.

entries.page: Knowledge base and teaching the assistant
entries.text:
Without any setup, the assistant reads:

- **Your catalog, live**: products, prices, variants and stock are checked at the moment a shopper asks, so they're never out of date
- **Your policies**: refund, shipping, privacy, terms and contact policies from Shopify
- **Your store pages**: published pages are read automatically, and re-read whenever you create or edit a page

The knowledge base is where you add everything else.

---

entries.page: Knowledge base and teaching the assistant
entries.text:
- In the app, open **Settings → Knowledge base training**

---

entries.page: Knowledge base and teaching the assistant
entries.text: FAQ pages, sizing guides, care instructions, store locations and similar. Only pages on your own store domain can be added.

entries.page: Knowledge base and teaching the assistant
entries.section: What you can add › Questions and answers
entries.text:
Short question-and-answer pairs for answers you want to control exactly. These are **used from the very next message**:

- If a shopper asks the same question (ignoring capitals and punctuation), the assistant replies with your answer word for word.
- If they ask it differently or in another language, the assistant uses your answer as the correct one, ahead of anything else it knows or said earlier in the chat.
- If you save the same question again, the newest answer wins.

entries.page: Knowledge base and teaching the assistant
entries.text:
PDF, DOC, DOCX or TXT (up to 5 MB), for example manuals and size charts.

Each source shows its status (queued, processing, trained or failed). If something fails, fix the source and add it again.

---

entries.page: Knowledge base and teaching the assistant
entries.section: Teach the assistant (Chats → Teach the assistant)
entries.text:
This list collects what's worth teaching, most frequent first:

- **Questions the assistant couldn't answer** from your store information, and answers shoppers rated as not helpful
- **Answers your team gave** in live chats that would help other shoppers (shipping, policies, product details). The team's answer is filled in for you; personal details and order numbers are removed. If it disagrees with an answer you already saved, both are shown so you can choose.

Click **Answer** or **Review & save**, adjust the text, and save. Nothing is added to your knowledge base without your approval.

---

entries.page: Knowledge base and teaching the assistant
entries.text:
In any conversation (**Chats**), every assistant reply has **Correct this answer**. Edit the answer and save it: the assistant uses it from the next message on.

Spend five minutes a week in **Teach the assistant**. It's the fastest way to make answers more accurate.

- In the app, open **Settings → Languages**

---

entries.section: Which language does the chat use?
entries.text:
- **The language the shopper is browsing your store in** (recommended): follows your store's languages in Shopify (Markets, Translate & Adapt). A shopper on your French storefront gets the chat in French.
- **The shopper's browser language**: useful if your store is in one language but your shoppers aren't.
- **Always one language**: pick it from the list.

Whatever you choose, the assistant answers in the language the shopper writes in.

Built in for **28 languages**: buttons, forms, the AI notice and every system line ("our team is joining", "you're chatting with the assistant again"…).

| | |
|---|---|
| Europe | English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Greek, Russian, Ukrainian |
| Asia & Middle East | Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Hindi, Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Turkish, Arabic, Hebrew |

Arabic and Hebrew chats are laid out right to left.

---

Set **Your texts are written in** to the language you type your texts in. Then, under **Translations**, click **Translate** next to a language. Languages you've translated are listed first; click **Show all 28 languages** (and use the finder) for the rest.

- Every text shoppers can see is listed (chat title, greeting, AI notice, live-chat lines, quick actions, popups, cart reminder), with your original under each field.
- **Fill empty fields with AI** drafts the translations for you. Placeholders like `{code}` and `{name}` stay as they are. Review, then **Save translations**, then save the page.
- **Preview** shows the chat in that language.

Empty fields use your original text, except system lines, which use the built-in translation for that language.

---

In **Settings → Live chat & handoff** you can reword:

- Message when the team is joining / offline
- When a team member joins (`{name}` becomes the team member's or your team's name)
- When the chat goes back to the assistant
- When nobody from the team could join

The AI notice under the chat header is in **Appearance → Window**. It's always shown (shoppers must be able to tell they're chatting with an AI), but you can word it your way.

A shopper is handed to your team when they:

- ask for a person (for example "Can I talk to someone?"), or
- use one of your **escalation keywords** (for example *chargeback*, *lawyer*, *allergic reaction*).

The assistant summarizes the conversation for you and tells the shopper someone will join shortly. If your team is offline (outside business hours, or nobody has the app open), the shopper leaves their email or phone instead, and you'll find the request in **Chats**.

---

- **Let shoppers chat with your team**: turn live chat on or off
- **Team name shown to shoppers**: for example "Store team" or "Ana"
- **Message when the team is joining** and **Message when the team is offline**
- **Escalation keywords**: comma-separated
- **Only offer live chat during business hours**: set your hours per day and **Time zone**
- **Email shoppers the replies they missed**: see below

Your team counts as available while someone has the app open in Shopify admin (any page) or the **team inbox** open.

entries.section: Settings (Settings → Live chat & handoff) › Online, Away, Offline
entries.text:
The badge next to the inbox tabs shows your status. Click it to switch:

- **Online**: shoppers who ask for a person are offered live chat while you have the app open.
- **Away**: having the app open doesn't offer shoppers live chat. Use it when you step away and leave the tab open. Teammates who are online can still take chats. Saved per browser.
- **Offline**: live chat is off, or it's outside your business hours. Shoppers leave their email or phone instead. Change this in **Settings → Live chat & handoff**.

---

- **In the app**: a sound and a notification on any page when a shopper is waiting or writes in a live chat. Turn the sound on or off with **Sound alerts** on the Chats page (saved per browser).
- **Email / Slack**: right away when a shopper asks for a person, and a reminder if a shopper has waited 3 minutes without a reply (once per wait). Set the recipients in **Settings → Notification settings**.

---

Open the conversation in **Chats** and reply. Sending a reply joins the chat and pauses the assistant (you can also click **Join chat**).

- **See what the shopper is typing** before they send it, live
- The shopper sees when you're typing
- **Suggest reply** (✨): the assistant drafts a reply as your team, using your products, the shopper's order and your saved answers. Edit it, then send. Nothing is sent automatically.
- **Saved replies**: insert one from the list, or type `/` in the reply box (for example `/ship`). `{first_name}` is filled in with the shopper's name when they shared it.
- **Attach** photos or PDFs (up to 3 per message, 5 MB each)

---

Click **Hand back to AI** when you're done, or **Close** the conversation. The shopper is then asked to rate the chat (1–5 stars); the rating appears on the conversation and in **Aixly impact** on your dashboard.

If nobody from the team replies, the assistant takes over again so the shopper is never stuck:

- **Nobody joined** within 5 minutes of the hand-off (your team gets a reminder at 3 minutes).
- **Someone joined** but hasn't replied or typed for 10 minutes.

The shopper then sees: *"Our team couldn't join right now, so the assistant will keep helping. Leave your email or phone if you'd like the team to follow up."* The note stays in the conversation history. If you reply afterwards, the chat is live with your team again. Change the wording in **Settings → Live chat & handoff**.

---

If you reply after the shopper has left the store and they gave their email in the chat, Aixly emails them your reply with a **Continue the chat** link. The link reopens the same conversation on any device and expires after 14 days. Turn this off with **Email shoppers the replies they missed**.

When a shopper wants to change something about an order, the assistant first verifies it's their order (order number plus email or phone, or automatically for logged-in customers), then records the request for your team:

- Cancel an order
- Change an order (address, items, …)
- Return, refund or exchange

---

With **Settings → Order lookup → File return requests in Shopify** on (the default):

1. The assistant lists the items on the order that can still be returned.
2. The shopper chooses the items, quantities and the reason (for example "too small" or "arrived damaged").
3. A **return request** is created in **Shopify → Orders → Returns**, with the reason and the shopper's own words.
4. You approve or decline it in Shopify, and Shopify emails the shopper the next steps (for example a return label).

The request also appears in **Requests** with a **Return … in Shopify** badge.

If an item can't be returned yet (for example the order hasn't shipped), the assistant explains that instead. If Shopify can't create the return for another reason, the request comes to **Requests** as usual, so nothing is lost.

Filing returns needs Shopify's returns permission. If you installed Aixly before this feature, Shopify asks you to approve it the next time you open the app.

---

In the app, open **Requests**:

- Filter by type and status
- Update the status: New, In progress, Resolved or Rejected
- **View chat** opens the conversation the request came from

- In the app, open **Plans**

---
We offer five plans to fit stores of every size. All plans include unlimited impressions, no commissions, and all core features.

- **Price:** $0/month
- **Conversations:** 10 per month
- **Features:** Unlimited impressions, no commissions, all core features, email support

The Starter plan is a great way to try the app at no cost. If you reach the conversation limit, the storefront widget will pause until your billing period resets.

---

- **Price:** $9.99/month
- **Free trial:** 7 days
- **Conversations:** 100 per month
- **Overage:** $0.20 per extra conversation (capped at $1,000/month)
- **Features:** Everything in Starter, plus branding removed

Best for new stores that want to remove the "Powered by" branding and handle moderate conversation volume.

---

- **Price:** $39.99/month
- **Free trial:** 7 days
- **Conversations:** 500 per month
- **Overage:** $0.15 per extra conversation (capped at $1,000/month)
- **Features:** Everything in Basic, plus priority email support

Best for growing stores with higher traffic and support needs.

---

- **Price:** $79.99/month
- **Free trial:** 7 days
- **Conversations:** 1,500 per month
- **Overage:** $0.10 per extra conversation (capped at $1,000/month)
- **Features:** Everything in Growth, plus priority support

Best for high-volume stores that need reliable, high-capacity AI support.

---

- **Price:** $129/month
- **Free trial:** 7 days
- **Conversations:** Unlimited
- **Features:** Everything in Pro with unlimited conversations and priority support

Best for stores that want zero limits and no overage surprises.

---

A **conversation** is a session window of **30 minutes**. All messages exchanged between a visitor and the chatbot within a 30-minute window count as a single conversation. If the visitor returns after the window expires, a new conversation begins.

---

All paid plans (Basic, Growth, Pro, and Unlimited) include a **7-day free trial**. You will not be charged until the trial ends. You can cancel anytime during the trial from your Shopify Admin billing settings.

---

Plans with overage billing (Basic, Growth, and Pro) charge a per-conversation fee once you exceed your monthly limit. Overage charges are capped so you are never billed more than **$1,000 in usage charges** in a single billing period.

| Plan   | Overage per conversation | Monthly cap |
|--------|--------------------------|-------------|
| Basic  | $0.20                    | $1,000      |
| Growth | $0.15                    | $1,000      |
| Pro    | $0.10                    | $1,000      |

Overage charges appear in:

- **Shopify Admin → Settings → Billing**
- The app’s **Analytics** page (Usage charges section)

---

You can change your plan at any time from the **Plans** page in the app. When you select a new plan, Shopify will ask you to confirm the subscription through its standard billing flow.

---

Your Plans page shows:

- Current conversation usage for the billing period
- The date your billing period resets

entries.page: Popups, cart reminder and proactive messages
entries.text:
- In the app, open **Appearance → Popups**

The preview shows the popup you're editing.

---

entries.page: Popups, cart reminder and proactive messages
entries.text:
- **Greeting on load**: a friendly prompt shortly after the page loads
- **Idle popup**: a prompt when the shopper hasn't interacted for a while
- **Promotion popup**: an offer or announcement

Popups never cover new messages from your team: message previews always take priority.

Best practice: keep popups short and helpful, and don't overdo promotions.

---

entries.page: Popups, cart reminder and proactive messages
entries.text:
Invite shoppers to chat after they've been browsing for a while:

- Enable **Proactive prompt**
- Set **Show after (seconds)** (recommended: 20–40)
- Optionally show it only once per session

---

entries.page: Popups, cart reminder and proactive messages
entries.text:
Recover carts with a gentle reminder, optionally with a discount code.

When it shows:

- The shopper has items in their cart, **and**
- they stay on the cart page for the time you set, **or** (on desktop) move to leave your store

Settings:

- **Remind shoppers about their cart**: turn it on
- **Message**: your text. Use `{code}` to include the discount code.
- **Discount code (optional)**: an existing code from **Shopify → Discounts**. Shoppers apply it with one **Apply code** click (it's added to their cart through Shopify's own discount link).
- **On the cart page after (seconds)**: 10–300
- **Show again after (days)**: 1–30

The reminder never appears while the chat is open or during a live chat. Orders placed after a shopper uses the reminder count toward **Aixly impact** on your dashboard.

Create a dedicated code for the reminder (for example `CART10`) so you can see in Shopify how often it's used.

Quick actions are buttons in the chat, above the message box, that help shoppers start common tasks with one tap.

Examples:

- "Track my order"
- "Size guide"
- "Talk to a person"

On phones they sit in one row that shoppers can swipe; on larger screens they wrap onto extra lines. They're hidden while your team is chatting live.

---

- In the app, open **Appearance → Quick actions** (up to 6)

---

- **Send a message**: posts a message into the chat and the assistant answers. Best for "Return policy", "Show bestsellers", "Talk to a person".
- **Open a link**: opens a page you choose. Best for your account page, contact page or a booking page.
- **Order status form**: shows a secure form for the order number and email/phone, then the order status. Best for "Track my order".

- In the app, open **Settings**

---

Chat with your assistant right inside Settings. It works exactly like the live widget but doesn't count toward your conversation quota, and it never creates real requests or returns.

---

Shoppers must prove an order is theirs before seeing its details. Choose what they enter together with the order number:

- Email only
- Phone only
- Email or phone

Logged-in customers are recognized automatically and can see their recent orders without entering anything. Repeated wrong guesses are blocked.

**File return requests in Shopify**: when on, a verified shopper picks the items and the reason in the chat, and a return request appears in **Shopify → Orders → Returns** for you to approve or decline (Shopify then emails them the next steps). When off, returns arrive in **Requests** like other order requests. See **Order requests and returns**.

---

See **Knowledge base and teaching the assistant**.

---

Suggest a specific link when shoppers ask about a topic, for example "Book a test ride" → your booking page.

---

- Formal or conversational tone
- Short or detailed answers
- Humor and emoji use
- Assistant name
- Your own instructions (brand voice, things to always mention)

Your instructions shape the tone, but they can't make the assistant invent prices, stock or policies: those always come from your store.

---

See **Live chat**. All the lines shoppers see during a hand-off can be reworded here.

---

Invite people to the team inbox. See **Team inbox**.

---

Create tickets in Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout or any system. See **Integrations → Helpdesk**.

---

See **Languages**.

---

Topics the assistant should politely decline (for example competitors or medical advice).

---

- **Hide on the cart page**
- **Hide on these pages**: paths starting with `/`, such as `/pages/contact` (subpages are included)

---

Keep conversations forever, or delete them automatically after 30 days to 2 years. Shared files are deleted with them.

---
- **Notification email** and **Slack incoming webhook URL** for alerts: a shopper asked for a person, a shopper has been waiting for a few minutes, or you're nearing your plan's limit

entries.page: Adding the chat to your store
entries.text:
You can use any of these at the same time; they all share the same conversation. The **Dashboard → Where shoppers find the chat** card shows what's live, and has the links and code below ready to copy.

---

entries.page: Adding the chat to your store
entries.text:
The main way to add Aixly: a chat button in the corner of every page, with optional popups and the cart reminder.

- **Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → Aixly AI Chatbot → Save**, or click **Turn on** on the Dashboard.
- Design it in **Appearance**; hide it on specific pages in **Settings → Where the chat appears**.

---

entries.page: Adding the chat to your store
entries.text:
Put the chat, always open, inside a page: product pages, a support or FAQ page, a landing page.

1. Click **Place on product page** on the Dashboard, or in the theme editor choose **Add block → Apps → Aixly chat window** in any section.
2. Set the **Height** and **Maximum width** in the block settings.
3. Save.

On pages with a chat window the floating button is hidden, so shoppers see one chat. The window shows even on pages where you've hidden the floating button.

---

entries.page: Adding the chat to your store
entries.text:
Use these in buttons, menus, emails or social posts (replace the domain with yours):

| Link | What it does |
|---|---|
| `https://your-store.com/?aixly_open=1` | Opens the chat |
| `https://your-store.com/?aixly=Where%20is%20my%20order%3F` | Opens the chat and asks the question |

Message text must be URL-encoded (spaces as `%20`, `?` as `%3F`). The parameter is removed from the address bar after the chat opens.

---

entries.page: Adding the chat to your store
entries.text: Add `data-aixly-open` to any link or button, for example in a **Custom Liquid** section: ```html Ask about shipping ``` With a value, the chat opens and asks that question. ---

entries.page: Adding the chat to your store

entries.text:
Your team can answer chats from any browser with their own sign-in. They don't need a Shopify account or access to your Shopify admin.

---

1. Open **Settings → Team**.
2. Enter their email, choose a role and click **Send invitation**.
   - **Agent**: answers and assigns chats.
   - **Manager**: also teaches the assistant (Teach the assistant, Correct this answer) and sees unanswered questions.
3. They open the link in the email (valid for 7 days, works once), enter their name and choose a password.

If email isn't set up for your store yet, the invitation link is shown so you can send it yourself with **Copy link**. Lost the email? Click **New link** next to the invitation (the old link stops working).

---

The team inbox is at **app.aixly.io/team**. It's the same live inbox as in the app: typing previews, suggested replies, saved replies, tags, files and alerts.

- The top bar shows the store and your role. People who help several stores switch between them there.
- **Inbox** and **Teach the assistant** (managers) are at the top left; **Sound on/off** at the top right.
- **Forgot your password?** on the sign-in page sends a reset link (valid for 1 hour). Resetting signs you out everywhere else.

---

Click your name or photo at the top right.

- **Edit profile**: your photo and your name (what your teammates see).
- **Change password**: enter your current password and a new one (10+ characters, with a number or symbol). Other devices are signed out; this one stays signed in.
- **Sign out**

Photos can be JPG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB. They're shown next to chats assigned to you.

---

Give each chat an owner. Anyone on the team can assign a chat to a teammate or to the store admin, and replying claims a chat nobody owns. See Assigning chats.

---

In **Settings → Team**:

- **Make manager / Make agent** changes the role.
- **Pause** stops access right away; **Restore** gives it back.
- **Remove** takes them off your team (their account stays for other stores they help).

Paused or removed people's chats go back to everyone.

---

By default replies are signed with your team name. Turn on **Show each team member's first name to shoppers** in **Settings → Live chat & handoff** to sign replies from the team inbox with the person's first name.

---
Passwords are stored as strong one-way hashes, repeated wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes, invitation and reset links work once, and access is checked on every request.

The chat widget helps shoppers:

- **Find products**: the assistant searches your live catalog and shows product cards with price, availability and an **Add to cart** button (with an option picker for products with variants)
- **Get answers**: shipping, returns, warranty, sizing and anything in your policies, store pages and knowledge base
- **Check orders**: status and tracking, after proving it's their order (logged-in customers are recognized automatically)
- **Request changes**: cancellations, changes, returns and refunds (returns can be filed directly in Shopify)
- **Reach your team**: live chat with your staff when they need a person

---

- Turn it on/off: **Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → Aixly AI Chatbot** (or add the **Aixly chat window** block to a page; see **Adding the chat to your store**)
- Design and popups: **Appearance**
- Assistant behavior, live chat, where it appears: **Settings**

---

- **Clearly an AI**: a short note under the header tells shoppers they're chatting with an AI assistant (and that they can ask for a person when live chat is on).
- **Fast, streamed answers** in the shopper's language. The interface is available in 28 languages (see **Languages**), right to left for Arabic and Hebrew.
- **Photos and PDFs**: shoppers can attach up to 3 files per message (JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB each), for example a photo of a damaged item. The assistant can look at photos. Files are checked for safety, and only the shopper and your team can open them.
- **Live chat**: when your team joins, the header shows "You're chatting with …", the shopper sees when you're typing, and replies arrive instantly.
- **New-message previews**: if the chat is closed when your team replies, the latest messages (up to 3) appear above the chat button with an unread count. They stay until the shopper opens the chat, even across pages.
- **Rating**: when your team leaves a live chat, the shopper is asked "How was your chat with …?" (1–5 stars, with an optional comment for low ratings).
- **Email follow-up**: if the shopper left before you replied and shared their email, they get your reply by email with a **Continue the chat** link that reopens the same conversation on any device. You can turn this off in **Settings → Live chat & handoff**.
- **Mobile**: the chat opens full screen, the page behind it doesn't scroll, and the keyboard never covers the message box. While the shopper types, the chat turns compact (smaller header; quick actions and the AI note step aside) so more of the conversation stays visible above the keyboard.

---

- Each shopper only ever sees their own conversation. Order details are shown only after verification.
- You decide how long conversations are kept (**Settings → Chat history retention**). Shopify's customer data requests and deletions are handled automatically.

entries.section: Recommended setup order › 1) Make the widget yours
entries.text:
- Open **Appearance**
- Set colors, the chat button (shape, size, icon or your own logo), greeting and quick actions
- The preview on the right shows exactly what shoppers will see
- Click **Save settings**

entries.section: Recommended setup order › 2) Teach the assistant your store
entries.text:
- Open **Settings → Knowledge base training**
- Add your FAQ, sizing and care pages, documents (size guides, manuals) and short question-and-answer pairs
- Your published store pages and policies are already read automatically

entries.section: Recommended setup order › 3) Set up live chat
entries.text:
- Open **Settings → Live chat & handoff**
- Choose the team name shoppers see, your business hours, and keywords that should always reach a person (for example *chargeback* or *allergic reaction*)
- In **Settings → Notification settings**, add the email (and optionally a Slack webhook) for alerts when a shopper is waiting

entries.section: Recommended setup order › 4) Choose how shoppers prove an order is theirs
entries.text:
- Open **Settings → Order lookup**
- Require the email, the phone, or either one, together with the order number. Logged-in customers don't need to enter anything.
- Decide whether returns are filed directly in Shopify (**File return requests in Shopify**)

entries.section: Recommended setup order › 5) Test it like a customer
entries.text:
Use **Settings → Try your bot**, or open your storefront in a private window and ask:

- "What's your return policy?"
- "Do you have this in size M?"
- "Where is my order?"
- "Can I talk to a person?" (then reply from **Chats**)

- Check **Chats → Teach the assistant** every few days and save answers for questions the assistant couldn't handle
- Use **Correct this answer** under any assistant reply in a conversation to fix it from the very next message

- Install **Aixly** from the Shopify App Store and approve the permissions Shopify shows you.
- The app opens inside **Shopify Admin → Apps → Aixly**. There's nothing else to connect: the app sets itself up the first time it opens.

Shopify asks you to approve them the next time you open the app after the update. Until you do, only the features that need them (for example, filing returns in Shopify) stay off. Everything else keeps working.

---

Open **Dashboard**. The **Setup Guide** walks you through:

- **AI processing**: your store pages and policies are read so the assistant can answer questions about them. This usually takes a minute or two. Products, prices and stock are always read live.
- **Turn on the widget**: opens your theme editor
- **Check it's live**: confirms the chat button appears on your storefront
- **Try your bot** and **choose a plan**

---

entries.section: 3) Turn on the chat widget (theme app embed)
entries.text:
In Shopify admin:

1. Go to **Online Store → Themes**
2. Click **Customize**
3. Open **App embeds**
4. Enable **Aixly AI Chatbot**
5. Click **Save**

---

Open your storefront: the chat button should appear (usually bottom right).

If it doesn't, go back to **Dashboard** and click **Refresh status** in the Setup Guide. Still nothing? See **Troubleshooting → Common issues**.

Aixly adds an **AI shopping assistant and live chat** to your Shopify store, plus an inbox inside your Shopify admin.

- The **AI assistant** answers shoppers 24/7 using your live store data: products, prices, stock, your policies, store pages and the answers you teach it. It recommends products, checks order status for verified shoppers, and files order requests and returns.
- When a shopper needs a person, your team **joins the chat live**, from the app or from the **team inbox** with their own sign-in (no Shopify access needed), and can assign each chat to the right person. The assistant pauses while you're there and takes over again when you leave.
- The assistant keeps getting better: questions it couldn't answer, and answers your team gave in live chats, appear in **Teach the assistant** for one-click approval.

---

- A chat button (launcher) on your storefront in your colors and style, and/or a chat window embedded in a page
- A chat window where they can:
  - ask about products and get product cards with **Add to cart**
  - check their order status (after verifying it's their order)
  - request a cancellation, change, return or refund
  - chat with your team, see when you're typing, and send photos or PDFs
- Previews of new messages from your team above the chat button, even after they've closed the chat
- A short rating question ("How was your chat with …?") after a live chat
- An email with your reply and a **Continue the chat** link, if they left before you answered and shared their email

Shoppers always see that they're chatting with an AI assistant. The chat follows your store's language (or the shopper's browser, or one language you choose) with everything built in for 28 languages (including right-to-left Arabic and Hebrew), and your own texts can be translated in one click. The assistant replies in the language the shopper writes in.

---

entries.section: What you manage inside Shopify admin
entries.text:
- **Dashboard**: setup guide, **Aixly impact** (sales influenced, share handled by the assistant, satisfaction), where shoppers find the chat, chat activity and recent chats
- **Analytics**: trends, engagement funnel, revenue attribution, usage
- **Chats**: the live inbox, and **Teach the assistant**
- **Requests**: order requests and returns captured in chat
- **Appearance**: widget design, chat button, popups, cart reminder, quick actions
- **Settings**: assistant behavior, order lookup, knowledge base, live chat, team, helpdesk, languages, notifications, privacy
- **Plans**: your plan and usage
- **Support**: help center, contact options, and privacy & EU compliance guidance

entries.page: Helpdesk (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout, webhook)
entries.text:
Already use a helpdesk? Aixly can create a ticket there when your team needs to follow up. Each ticket has the AI summary, the shopper's request, their contact details, the chat transcript and a link to the conversation in Aixly.

---

entries.page: Helpdesk (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout, webhook)
entries.text:
Open **Settings → Helpdesk**, pick your helpdesk and fill in:

| Helpdesk | You need | Where to find it |
|---|---|---|
| Zendesk | Subdomain, agent email, API token | Admin Center → Apps and integrations → Zendesk API |
| Freshdesk | Subdomain, API key | Profile picture → Profile settings → View API key |
| Gorgias | Subdomain, account email, API key | Settings → REST API |
| Help Scout | App ID, App secret, Mailbox ID | Your profile → My Apps → Create app; the mailbox ID is in the mailbox URL |
| Webhook | An https URL (optional signing secret) | Zapier, Make or your own system |

Click **Connect**, then **Send a test ticket** to check it works. The test ticket opens in a new tab.

---

entries.page: Helpdesk (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout, webhook)
entries.text:
Choose any of:

- A shopper leaves their contact details because your team is offline
- A shopper asks to cancel, change or return an order
- A shopper waits 3 minutes in a live chat without a reply

If your helpdesk is briefly unavailable, Aixly retries automatically (over about 16 hours). **Recent tickets** shows each one with a link, and **Retry** for any that failed.

---

entries.page: Helpdesk (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout, webhook)
entries.text:
Each ticket is sent as JSON (`event`: `aixly.ticket.contact`, `aixly.ticket.order` or `aixly.ticket.unanswered`) with the subject, text, contact details, summary, transcript and conversation link.

If you set a signing secret, verify requests with the `X-Aixly-Timestamp` and `X-Aixly-Signature` headers: the signature is `sha256=` followed by the HMAC-SHA256 of `timestamp.body`, using your secret.

---

entries.page: Helpdesk (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout, webhook)
entries.text: Credentials are stored encrypted and are only visible to the store (never to team-inbox members). Disconnecting stops new tickets.

entries.section: How Aixly works with Shopify › Installation and permissions
entries.text:
Aixly uses Shopify's standard installation: you approve permissions on Shopify's own screen, and when an update needs a new permission, Shopify asks you the next time you open the app. Aixly asks for:

| Permission | Used for |
|---|---|
| Products | Live product answers, product cards, add to cart |
| Orders | Order status for verified shoppers, order requests, sales attribution |
| Customers | Recognizing logged-in customers and their orders |
| Returns | Filing return requests from the chat (**Shopify → Orders → Returns**) |
| Legal policies, online store pages | Answering questions about your policies and store pages |
| Themes | Checking that the chat widget is turned on in your theme |

entries.section: How Aixly works with Shopify › Theme app embed (storefront)
entries.text: The widget is added with a theme app embed, so your theme code isn't changed: **Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds → Aixly AI Chatbot**. Turning the embed off removes the widget.

entries.section: How Aixly works with Shopify › Logged-in customers
entries.text: Through a secure Shopify app proxy, the widget knows when a customer is logged in, so they can see their own recent orders without typing an order number or email.

entries.section: How Aixly works with Shopify › Orders, returns and discounts
entries.text:
- **Orders**: new orders are matched to recent chats for **Aixly impact**. No customer contact details are stored for this.
- **Returns**: return requests are created in Shopify for you to approve or decline. See **Order requests and returns**.
- **Discounts**: the cart reminder applies an existing discount code from **Shopify → Discounts**. Aixly never creates or changes discounts.

entries.section: How Aixly works with Shopify › Billing
entries.text: Plans are charged through Shopify billing. Usage charges (if your plan has them) appear in **Shopify Admin → Settings → Billing**.

entries.section: How Aixly works with Shopify › Customer privacy
entries.text: Shopify's customer data requests and deletion requests (GDPR) are handled automatically, and uninstalling the app removes your store's data after Shopify's required waiting period.
This page is general guidance to help you get started. It isn't legal advice, and other regions have their own rules. Please check your privacy policy with a legal professional.

entries.section: What Aixly already does for you
entries.text:
- **AI is always recognizable.** The chat shows shoppers "You're chatting with an AI assistant" in their language, as the EU AI Act's transparency rules require. When your team joins, the chat says so.
- **Order details only after verification.** Shoppers prove an order is theirs (order number plus email or phone, or being logged in) before seeing it.
- **Retention you control.** Choose how long conversations and shared files are kept in **Settings → Chat history retention**.
- **Data requests handled.** Shopify's customer data and deletion requests (GDPR) are processed automatically, and your store's data is removed after you uninstall.
- **Analytics consent.** Analytics events follow your store's cookie consent (Shopify Customer Privacy).

---

1. **Mention the chat in your privacy policy** (template below).
2. **Pick a retention period** that matches your policy (**Settings → Chat history retention**).
3. If you have staff in the chat, make sure they know conversations are stored and visible to your team.

---

Adapt this to your store and add it to your privacy policy (**Settings → Policies** in Shopify admin):

> **Chat assistant.** Our website offers a chat, provided by Aixly, where you can ask questions about our products, your orders and our policies. Answers are generated by an AI assistant; members of our team may also reply. We process the messages you send, any files you attach, and contact details you choose to share (such as your email address or phone number) in order to answer your questions, help with your orders and improve our service. If you're logged in, we use your customer account to show your own orders. Chat conversations are stored for [retention period] and then deleted. The AI responses are generated using OpenAI as a sub-processor. You can ask us to access or delete your chat data at any time by contacting us at [your contact email].

---

entries.section: Do I need a cookie banner for the chat?
entries.text: The chat stores small items in the shopper's browser to keep their conversation across pages, which is needed for the chat to work. Analytics events respect your store's existing cookie consent banner. If you're unsure, ask your legal advisor.

entries.section: Widget not showing on the storefront
entries.text:
1. **Check the embed is on**: Shopify admin → **Online Store → Themes → Customize** → **App embeds** → enable **Aixly AI Chatbot** → **Save**. Make sure you're editing your *published* theme.
2. **Check the Setup Guide**: app → **Dashboard** → **Refresh status**.
3. **Check Appearance**: app → **Appearance → Button** → **Show launcher** is on.
4. **Check where it appears**: app → **Settings → Where the chat appears**. It may be hidden on the cart page or on paths you listed.
5. **Wait and refresh**: changes can take up to 2 minutes to reach your storefront.

---

Most often your **Starter plan** monthly conversation limit was reached. Open **Plans** to upgrade, or wait until the period resets.

---

entries.section: The app keeps asking me to approve permissions, or a feature says it needs permission
entries.text:
Shopify asks for new permissions when you open the app after an update. Approve them on Shopify's screen. If you dismissed it, reload the app from **Shopify Admin → Apps → Aixly**. Features that need a missing permission (for example filing returns in Shopify) simply stay off until then.

---

entries.section: Shoppers can't reach my team / live chat isn't offered
entries.text:
- **Settings → Live chat & handoff**: **Let shoppers chat with your team** must be on.
- If **Only offer live chat during business hours** is on, check the hours and **Time zone**.
- Someone needs to have the app open in Shopify admin (any page) for the team to count as available. Otherwise shoppers leave their contact details instead, and you'll find the request in **Chats**.

---

- Check **Settings → Notification settings**: the notification email is correct.
- Look in your spam folder, and add the sender to your contacts.
- For instant alerts while you work, keep the app open; turn on **Sound alerts** on the Chats page.

---

entries.section: A shopper didn't get my reply by email
entries.text:
Missed-reply emails are only sent when the shopper left before your reply **and** shared their email in the chat, and **Email shoppers the replies they missed** is on. They're sent about 2 minutes after your reply.

---

- **URLs**: use pages on your own store domain with readable text (not mostly images).
- **Documents**: PDF, DOC, DOCX or TXT, up to 5 MB.

---

- Open **Chats → Teach the assistant** and save answers for the questions listed there.
- Use **Correct this answer** on wrong replies in **Chats**: the fix applies from the next message.
- Add your FAQ, shipping and sizing pages in **Settings → Knowledge base training**.
- Check **Settings → Personality** instructions don't contradict your policies.

---

entries.section: Order tracking can't find an order
entries.text:
- The shopper needs the **order number** and the **email or phone used on that order**. **Settings → Order lookup** decides which one proves the order is theirs. Logged-in customers don't need either.
- Only orders from the **last 60 days** can be looked up.
- Test with a real order from your store, using the exact email on the order.
- If the assistant says order information is **unavailable** for every order, contact us from **Support → Ask Aixly → Email our team** so we can check your store.

---

entries.section: A return wasn't created in Shopify
entries.text:
- **Settings → Order lookup → File return requests in Shopify** must be on, and the returns permission approved.
- Only items that have been fulfilled and not already returned can be returned. Otherwise the assistant explains this, or the request goes to **Requests**.
